title: Saudi-Led Coalition Warns Houthis Against Arms Smuggling, Reports Intercepting a Vessel
detail: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen warned the Houthis against smuggling weapons and said it had intercepted a vessel. Details on the vessel, cargo and location were not given in the feed; claims are coalition statements and unverified independently.

media.caption: Saudi-led coalition warns Houthis against arms smuggling

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Reports Intercepting Houthi Ballistic Missile Launched Toward Riyadh
detail: A Saudi-led coalition interception of a Houthi ballistic missile launched toward Riyadh was reported in a news-aggregator headline. Outlet, launch time, debris impact and any damage were not available in the feed; the claim is unverified pending primary confirmation.

title: Death Toll Rises to 73 in Houthi Strike on Yemen Training Camp
detail: An aggregated headline reports the death toll from the Houthi strike on a Yemeni training camp has risen to 73, up from 53 previously reported, making it the deadliest attack in months. Figure comes from a news-aggregator headline without outlet detail; unverified pending primary confirmation.

title: UK Reported to Send Jets to Defend Saudi Arabia From Houthi Attacks
detail: An aggregated headline reports the UK will send jets to help defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks. Deployment size, timing and basis were not available in the feed; unverified pending primary confirmation.

title: Iran Says Saudi Arabia and Houthis Have Not Responded to Tehran's Mediation Initiative
detail: Iran's foreign minister said neither Saudi Arabia nor Yemen's Houthis have responded to Tehran's mediation initiative. This is an Iranian official statement; the other parties have not commented in the feed.
